parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT
        e.id AS source_event_id,
        e.customer_id,
        changes.field_name,
        changes.current_value,
        changes.proposed_value

    FROM source_events e

    JOIN customers c
      ON c.id = e.customer_id

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES
        (
            'phone',
            c.phone,
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(e.payload #>> '{customer,phone}'),
                ''
            )
        ),
        (
            'company',
            c.company,
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(e.payload #>> '{customer,company}'),
                ''
            )
        )
    ) AS changes (
        field_name,
        current_value,
        proposed_value
    )

    WHERE e.customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.status = 'ready'
      AND c.hubspot_contact_id IS NOT NULL
      AND changes.proposed_value IS NOT NULL
      AND changes.proposed_value IS DISTINCT FROM
          changes.current_value
),

inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO contact_change_proposals (
        source_event_id,
        customer_id,
        field_name,
        current_value,
        proposed_value
    )

    SELECT
        source_event_id,
        customer_id,
        field_name,
        current_value,
        proposed_value
    FROM candidates

    ON CONFLICT (source_event_id, field_name)
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING *
)

SELECT *
FROM inserted;
